<?php
class Manager
{
    private array $total = [],
        $available = [],
        $processes = [],
        $queue = [],
        $history = [],
        $snapshots = [];
    private string $mode = "AVOID",
        $policy = "ALLOC";
    private bool $trace = false,
        $auto = false;
    private int $time = 0;
    private const KINDS = [
        "granted",
        "blocked",
        "unblocked",
        "released",
        "finished",
        "aborted",
        "cancelled",
    ];

    private function out(string $s): void
    {
        echo $s, "\n";
    }
    private function vec(array $v): string
    {
        return "(" . implode(",", $v) . ")";
    }
    private function names(array $ids): string
    {
        return implode(" ", array_map(fn($p) => "P$p", $ids));
    }
    private function zero(): array
    {
        return array_fill(0, count($this->total), 0);
    }
    private function add(array $a, array $b): array
    {
        return array_map(fn($x, $y) => $x + $y, $a, $b);
    }
    private function sub(array $a, array $b): array
    {
        return array_map(fn($x, $y) => $x - $y, $a, $b);
    }
    private function fits(array $a, array $b): bool
    {
        foreach ($a as $i => $x) {
            if ($x > $b[$i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    private function ids(?array $ps = null): array
    {
        $ids = array_keys($ps ?? $this->processes);
        sort($ids, SORT_NUMERIC);
        return $ids;
    }
    private function need(int $id, ?array $ps = null): array
    {
        $p = ($ps ?? $this->processes)[$id];
        return $this->sub($p["max"], $p["alloc"]);
    }
    private function blocked(int $id, ?array $queue = null): ?array
    {
        foreach ($queue ?? $this->queue as $q) {
            if ($q[0] === $id) {
                return $q;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    private function check(
        bool $detect = false,
        bool $trace = false,
        ?array $av = null,
        ?array $ps = null,
        ?array $queue = null,
    ): array {
        $ps ??= $this->processes;
        $queue ??= $this->queue;
        $work = $av ?? $this->available;
        $idle = [];
        $remaining = [];
        foreach ($this->ids($ps) as $p) {
            if ($detect && array_sum($ps[$p]["alloc"]) === 0) {
                $idle[] = $p;
            } else {
                $remaining[] = $p;
            }
        }
        $sequence = [];
        $label = $detect ? "detect" : "safety";
        if ($trace) {
            $suffix = $idle ? " idle " . $this->names($idle) : "";
            $this->out("[$label] start work=" . $this->vec($work) . $suffix);
        }
        while (true) {
            $chosen = null;
            foreach ($remaining as $p) {
                $q = $this->blocked($p, $queue);
                $required = $detect ? ($q ? $q[1] : $this->zero()) : $this->need($p, $ps);
                if ($this->fits($required, $work)) {
                    $chosen = $p;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ($chosen === null) {
                break;
            }
            $work = $this->add($work, $ps[$chosen]["alloc"]);
            $remaining = array_values(array_diff($remaining, [$chosen]));
            $sequence[] = $chosen;
            if ($trace) {
                $this->out("[$label] P$chosen can finish, work=" . $this->vec($work));
            }
        }
        if ($trace && $remaining) {
            $this->out(
                "[$label] stuck work=" .
                    $this->vec($work) .
                    " remaining " .
                    $this->names($remaining),
            );
        }
        return [!$remaining, $sequence, $remaining];
    }
    private function reject(int $id, array $v): ?string
    {
        if ($this->blocked($id)) {
            return "process P$id is blocked";
        }
        if (array_sum($v) === 0) {
            return "zero vector";
        }
        if (!$this->fits($v, $this->need($id))) {
            return "request exceeds need";
        }
        $last = -1;
        foreach ($this->processes[$id]["alloc"] as $i => $x) {
            if ($x > 0) {
                $last = $i;
            }
        }
        if ($this->mode === "ORDER") {
            foreach ($v as $i => $x) {
                if ($x > 0 && $i <= $last) {
                    return "resource order violation";
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    private function decision(int $id, array $v, ?bool $trace = null): array
    {
        if (!$this->fits($v, $this->available)) {
            return [false, "insufficient resources", []];
        }
        if ($this->mode === "AVOID") {
            $ps = $this->processes;
            $ps[$id]["alloc"] = $this->add($ps[$id]["alloc"], $v);
            [$safe, $sequence] = $this->check(
                false,
                $trace ?? $this->trace,
                $this->sub($this->available, $v),
                $ps,
            );
            if (!$safe) {
                return [false, "unsafe state", []];
            }
            return [true, "", $sequence];
        }
        return [true, "", []];
    }
    private function record(string $kind, int $id, array $v, ?int $wait = null): void
    {
        $this->history[] = [$this->time, $kind, $id, $v, $wait];
    }
    private function grant(int $id, array $v): void
    {
        $this->available = $this->sub($this->available, $v);
        $this->processes[$id]["alloc"] = $this->add($this->processes[$id]["alloc"], $v);
    }
    private function retryQueue(): void
    {
        $old = $this->queue;
        $this->queue = [];
        foreach ($old as [$id, $v, $since]) {
            if ($this->decision($id, $v)[0]) {
                $this->grant($id, $v);
                $this->out("unblocked P$id " . $this->vec($v));
                $this->record("unblocked", $id, $v, $this->time - $since);
            } else {
                $this->queue[] = [$id, $v, $since];
            }
        }
    }
    private function terminate(int $id, string $kind, bool $retry = true): void
    {
        $v = $this->processes[$id]["alloc"];
        $this->available = $this->add($this->available, $v);
        unset($this->processes[$id]);
        $this->queue = array_values(array_filter($this->queue, fn($q) => $q[0] !== $id));
        $this->out("$kind P$id released " . $this->vec($v));
        $this->record($kind, $id, $v);
        if ($retry) {
            $this->retryQueue();
        }
    }
    private function requireThat(bool $valid, string $message): void
    {
        if (!$valid) {
            throw new RuntimeException($message);
        }
    }
    public function run(string $line, int $time): void
    {
        $this->time = $time;
        $args = explode(" ", $line);
        $cmd = array_shift($args);
        $id = isset($args[0]) ? (int) $args[0] : 0;
        $withId = in_array($cmd, ["PROCESS", "CLAIM", "REQUEST", "WHATIF", "RELEASE"], true);
        $v = array_map("intval", $withId ? array_slice($args, 1) : $args);
        try {
            if ($withId || in_array($cmd, ["ADD", "REMOVE"], true)) {
                $this->requireThat(count($v) === count($this->total), "wrong vector length");
            }
            if (
                in_array(
                    $cmd,
                    [
                        "CLAIM",
                        "REQUEST",
                        "WHATIF",
                        "RELEASE",
                        "FINISH",
                        "ABORT",
                        "CANCEL",
                        "MAXGRANT",
                    ],
                    true,
                )
            ) {
                $this->requireThat(isset($this->processes[$id]), "unknown process P$id");
            }
            switch ($cmd) {
                case "RESOURCES":
                    $this->total = $this->available = $v;
                    $this->processes = $this->queue = $this->history = [];
                    $this->out("resources " . $this->vec($v));
                    break;
                case "MODE":
                case "POLICY":
                case "TRACE":
                case "AUTODETECT":
                    if ($cmd === "MODE") {
                        $this->mode = $args[0];
                    } elseif ($cmd === "POLICY") {
                        $this->policy = $args[0];
                    } elseif ($cmd === "TRACE") {
                        $this->trace = $args[0] === "ON";
                    } else {
                        $this->auto = $args[0] === "ON";
                    }
                    $this->out(strtolower($cmd) . " " . $args[0]);
                    break;
                case "PROCESS":
                    $this->requireThat(!isset($this->processes[$id]), "duplicate process P$id");
                    $this->requireThat($this->fits($v, $this->total), "max exceeds total");
                    $this->processes[$id] = [
                        "max" => $v,
                        "alloc" => $this->zero(),
                        "born" => $time,
                    ];
                    $this->out("process P$id max " . $this->vec($v));
                    break;
                case "CLAIM":
                    $this->requireThat(!$this->blocked($id), "process P$id is blocked");
                    $this->requireThat(
                        $this->fits($this->processes[$id]["alloc"], $v),
                        "claim below allocation",
                    );
                    $this->requireThat($this->fits($v, $this->total), "max exceeds total");
                    $ps = $this->processes;
                    $ps[$id]["max"] = $v;
                    $this->requireThat(
                        $this->mode !== "AVOID" || $this->check(false, $this->trace, null, $ps)[0],
                        "claim makes state unsafe",
                    );
                    $this->processes[$id]["max"] = $v;
                    $this->out("claim P$id max " . $this->vec($v));
                    $this->retryQueue();
                    break;
                case "ADD":
                case "REMOVE":
                    $this->requireThat(array_sum($v) !== 0, "zero vector");
                    if ($cmd === "ADD") {
                        $this->total = $this->add($this->total, $v);
                        $this->available = $this->add($this->available, $v);
                        $this->out(
                            "added " . $this->vec($v) . " total " . $this->vec($this->total),
                        );
                        $this->retryQueue();
                    } else {
                        $this->requireThat(
                            $this->fits($v, $this->available),
                            "remove exceeds available",
                        );
                        $total = $this->sub($this->total, $v);
                        $this->requireThat(!in_array(0, $total, true), "total must stay positive");
                        foreach ($this->processes as $p) {
                            $this->requireThat($this->fits($p["max"], $total), "max exceeds total");
                        }
                        $av = $this->sub($this->available, $v);
                        $this->requireThat(
                            $this->mode !== "AVOID" || $this->check(false, $this->trace, $av)[0],
                            "removal makes state unsafe",
                        );
                        $this->total = $total;
                        $this->available = $av;
                        $this->out("removed " . $this->vec($v) . " total " . $this->vec($total));
                    }
                    break;
                case "REQUEST":
                case "WHATIF":
                    $reason = $this->reject($id, $v);
                    if ($reason !== null) {
                        if ($cmd === "REQUEST") {
                            throw new RuntimeException($reason);
                        }
                        $this->out("whatif P$id " . $this->vec($v) . ": rejected ($reason)");
                        break;
                    }
                    [$granted, $reason, $sequence] = $this->decision($id, $v);
                    if ($cmd === "WHATIF") {
                        $result = $granted ? "granted" : "blocked ($reason)";
                        if ($granted && $this->mode === "AVOID") {
                            $result .= ", safe sequence " . $this->names($sequence);
                        }
                        $this->out("whatif P$id " . $this->vec($v) . ": $result");
                    } elseif ($granted) {
                        $this->grant($id, $v);
                        $this->out("granted P$id " . $this->vec($v));
                        $this->record("granted", $id, $v);
                    } else {
                        $this->queue[] = [$id, $v, $time];
                        $this->out("blocked P$id " . $this->vec($v) . ": $reason");
                        $this->record("blocked", $id, $v);
                        if ($this->auto) {
                            $dead = $this->check(true, $this->trace)[2];
                            if ($dead) {
                                $this->out("deadlock detected: " . $this->names($dead));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                case "RELEASE":
                    $this->requireThat(!$this->blocked($id), "process P$id is blocked");
                    $this->requireThat(array_sum($v) !== 0, "zero vector");
                    $this->requireThat(
                        $this->fits($v, $this->processes[$id]["alloc"]),
                        "release exceeds allocation",
                    );
                    $this->available = $this->add($this->available, $v);
                    $this->processes[$id]["alloc"] = $this->sub($this->processes[$id]["alloc"], $v);
                    $this->out("released P$id " . $this->vec($v));
                    $this->record("released", $id, $v);
                    $this->retryQueue();
                    break;
                case "FINISH":
                case "ABORT":
                    $this->requireThat(
                        $cmd !== "FINISH" || !$this->blocked($id),
                        "process P$id is blocked",
                    );
                    $this->terminate($id, $cmd === "FINISH" ? "finished" : "aborted");
                    break;
                case "CANCEL":
                    $q = $this->blocked($id);
                    $this->requireThat($q !== null, "process P$id is not blocked");
                    $this->queue = array_values(
                        array_filter($this->queue, fn($q) => $q[0] !== $id),
                    );
                    $this->out("cancelled P$id " . $this->vec($q[1]));
                    $this->record("cancelled", $id, $q[1]);
                    break;
                case "MAXGRANT":
                    $this->requireThat(!$this->blocked($id), "process P$id is blocked");
                    $result = $this->zero();
                    foreach ($this->need($id) as $i => $n) {
                        for ($x = $n; $x > 0; --$x) {
                            $w = $this->zero();
                            $w[$i] = $x;
                            if (
                                $this->reject($id, $w) === null &&
                                $this->decision($id, $w, false)[0]
                            ) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        $result[$i] = $x;
                    }
                    $this->out("maxgrant P$id: " . $this->vec($result));
                    break;
                case "SAFE":
                    if (!$this->processes) {
                        $this->out("safe: no processes");
                    } else {
                        [$safe, $seq, $remaining] = $this->check(false, $this->trace);
                        $this->out(
                            $safe
                                ? "safe: " . $this->names($seq)
                                : "unsafe: " . $this->names($remaining) . " cannot finish",
                        );
                    }
                    break;
                case "SEQUENCES":
                    if (!$this->processes) {
                        $this->out("safe sequences: no processes");
                        break;
                    }
                    $count = 0;
                    $first = [];
                    $visit = function ($work, $remaining, $path) use (
                        &$visit,
                        &$count,
                        &$first,
                        $id,
                    ) {
                        if (!$remaining) {
                            ++$count;
                            if (count($first) < $id) {
                                $first[] = $path;
                            }
                            return;
                        }
                        foreach ($remaining as $p) {
                            if ($this->fits($this->need($p), $work)) {
                                $visit(
                                    $this->add($work, $this->processes[$p]["alloc"]),
                                    array_values(array_diff($remaining, [$p])),
                                    [...$path, $p],
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    $visit($this->available, $this->ids(), []);
                    $this->out("safe sequences: $count");
                    foreach ($first as $path) {
                        $this->out($this->names($path));
                    }
                    break;
                case "DEFICIT":
                    $result = [];
                    foreach ($this->total as $i => $_) {
                        $limit = 0;
                        foreach ($this->ids() as $p) {
                            $limit += $this->need($p)[$i];
                        }
                        $answer = "-";
                        for ($x = 0; $x <= $limit; ++$x) {
                            $av = $this->available;
                            $av[$i] += $x;
                            if ($this->check(false, false, $av)[0]) {
                                $answer = $x;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        $result[] = $answer;
                    }
                    $this->out("deficit: " . $this->vec($result));
                    break;
                case "STATE":
                    $this->stateTable();
                    break;
                case "STATS":
                    $this->statistics();
                    break;
                case "DETECT":
                    $dead = $this->check(true, $this->trace)[2];
                    $this->out($dead ? "deadlocked: " . $this->names($dead) : "no deadlock");
                    break;
                case "VICTIMS":
                    $dead = $this->check(true)[2];
                    if (!$dead) {
                        $this->out("no deadlock");
                        break;
                    }
                    $candidates = [];
                    for ($mask = 1; $mask < 1 << count($dead); ++$mask) {
                        $set = [];
                        $sum = 0;
                        foreach ($dead as $i => $p) {
                            if ($mask & (1 << $i)) {
                                $set[] = $p;
                                $sum += array_sum($this->processes[$p]["alloc"]);
                            }
                        }
                        $candidates[] = [$set, $sum];
                    }
                    usort(
                        $candidates,
                        fn($a, $b) => count($a[0]) <=> count($b[0]) ?:
                        $a[1] <=> $b[1] ?:
                        $a[0] <=> $b[0],
                    );
                    foreach ($candidates as [$set, $_]) {
                        $ps = $this->processes;
                        $av = $this->available;
                        foreach ($set as $p) {
                            $av = $this->add($av, $ps[$p]["alloc"]);
                            unset($ps[$p]);
                        }
                        $queue = array_values(
                            array_filter($this->queue, fn($q) => !in_array($q[0], $set, true)),
                        );
                        if ($this->check(true, false, $av, $ps, $queue)[0]) {
                            $this->out("victims: " . $this->names($set));
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                case "RECOVER":
                    $count = 0;
                    while (true) {
                        $dead = $this->check(true, $this->trace)[2];
                        if (!$dead) {
                            break;
                        }
                        if (($args[0] ?? "") === "ALL") {
                            foreach ($dead as $p) {
                                $this->terminate($p, "aborted", false);
                            }
                            $count += count($dead);
                            $this->retryQueue();
                            break;
                        }
                        usort($dead, function ($a, $b) {
                            if ($this->policy === "ALLOC") {
                                return array_sum($this->processes[$a]["alloc"]) <=>
                                    array_sum($this->processes[$b]["alloc"]) ?:
                                    $b <=> $a;
                            }
                            if ($this->policy === "NEED") {
                                return array_sum($this->need($b)) <=> array_sum($this->need($a)) ?:
                                    $b <=> $a;
                            }
                            return $this->processes[$b]["born"] <=> $this->processes[$a]["born"];
                        });
                        $this->terminate($dead[0], "aborted");
                        ++$count;
                    }
                    $this->out($count ? "recovered: $count aborted" : "no deadlock");
                    break;
                case "WAITGRAPH":
                case "GRAPH":
                    $this->graph($cmd === "GRAPH");
                    break;
                case "HISTORY":
                    $found = false;
                    foreach ($this->history as [$t, $kind, $p, $w, $wait]) {
                        if ($args && $args[0] !== $kind && !(ctype_digit($args[0]) && $p === $id)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        $this->out(
                            "t=$t $kind P$p " .
                                $this->vec($w) .
                                ($kind === "unblocked" ? " waited $wait" : ""),
                        );
                        $found = true;
                    }
                    if (!$found) {
                        $this->out("no events");
                    }
                    break;
                case "SNAPSHOT":
                    $this->snapshots[$args[0]] = [
                        $this->total,
                        $this->available,
                        $this->processes,
                        $this->queue,
                        $this->history,
                    ];
                    $this->out("saved " . $args[0]);
                    break;
                case "RESTORE":
                    $this->requireThat(
                        isset($this->snapshots[$args[0]]),
                        "unknown snapshot " . $args[0],
                    );
                    [
                        $this->total,
                        $this->available,
                        $this->processes,
                        $this->queue,
                        $this->history,
                    ] = $this->snapshots[$args[0]];
                    $this->out("restored " . $args[0]);
                    break;
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->out("error: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
    private function stateTable(): void
    {
        $widths = array_map(fn($x) => strlen((string) $x), $this->total);
        $table = function ($v) use ($widths) {
            $a = [];
            foreach ($v as $i => $x) {
                $a[] = str_pad((string) $x, $widths[$i], " ", STR_PAD_LEFT);
            }
            return implode(" ", $a);
        };
        $name = $table(array_map(fn($i) => chr(65 + $i), array_keys($this->total)));
        $columns = array_map(fn($w) => max($w, strlen($name)), [10, 3, 4, 7]);
        $row = function ($heading, $content) use ($columns) {
            $s = str_pad($heading, 9);
            foreach ($content as $i => $x) {
                $s .= "  " . str_pad($x, $columns[$i]);
            }
            $this->out(rtrim($s));
        };
        $row("Process", ["Allocation", "Max", "Need", "Request"]);
        $row("", array_fill(0, 4, $name));
        foreach ($this->ids() as $p) {
            $q = $this->blocked($p);
            $row(
                "P$p",
                array_map($table, [
                    $this->processes[$p]["alloc"],
                    $this->processes[$p]["max"],
                    $this->need($p),
                    $q ? $q[1] : $this->zero(),
                ]),
            );
        }
        $row("Available", [$table($this->available), "", "", ""]);
        $row("Total", [$table($this->total), "", "", ""]);
        $requests = array_map(
            fn($q) => "P{$q[0]} " . $this->vec($q[1]) . " since t={$q[2]}",
            $this->queue,
        );
        $this->out("blocked queue: " . ($requests ? implode(", ", $requests) : "empty"));
    }
    private function statistics(): void
    {
        foreach ($this->total as $i => $total) {
            $used = $total - $this->available[$i];
            $p = intdiv($used * 1000, $total);
            $q = 0;
            foreach ($this->queue as $request) {
                $q += $request[1][$i];
            }
            $this->out(
                chr(65 + $i) .
                    ": allocated $used/$total (" .
                    intdiv($p, 10) .
                    "." .
                    $p % 10 .
                    "%), requested $q",
            );
        }
        $counts = array_fill_keys(self::KINDS, 0);
        $waits = [];
        foreach ($this->history as $e) {
            ++$counts[$e[1]];
            if ($e[1] === "unblocked") {
                $waits[] = $e[4];
            }
        }
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($counts as $k => $n) {
            $parts[] = "$k $n";
        }
        $this->out("events: " . implode(", ", $parts));
        if (!$waits) {
            $this->out("waits: none");
        } else {
            $n = count($waits);
            $sum = array_sum($waits);
            $avg = intdiv($sum * 100, $n);
            $this->out(
                "waits: $n unblocked, total $sum, average " .
                    intdiv($avg, 100) .
                    "." .
                    str_pad((string) ($avg % 100), 2, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT),
            );
        }
    }
    private function graph(bool $single): void
    {
        $this->requireThat(
            !$single || count(array_filter($this->total, fn($x) => $x !== 1)) === 0,
            "not single-instance",
        );
        $ids = $this->ids();
        $edges = array_fill_keys($ids, []);
        $edgeCount = 0;
        if ($single) {
            foreach ($this->total as $i => $_) {
                foreach ($ids as $p) {
                    if ($this->processes[$p]["alloc"][$i]) {
                        $this->out("assign " . chr(65 + $i) . " -> P$p");
                    }
                };
            }
            foreach ($ids as $p) {
                $q = $this->blocked($p);
                if (!$q) {
                    continue;
                }
                foreach ($q[1] as $i => $x) {
                    if ($x) {
                        $this->out("request P$p -> " . chr(65 + $i));
                        foreach ($ids as $j) {
                            if ($this->processes[$j]["alloc"][$i]) {
                                $edges[$p][] = [$i, $j];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            foreach ($ids as $p) {
                $q = $this->blocked($p);
                foreach ($this->need($p) as $i => $x) {
                    if ($x && (!$q || !$q[1][$i])) {
                        $this->out("claim P$p -> " . chr(65 + $i));
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            foreach ($ids as $p) {
                $q = $this->blocked($p);
                if (!$q) {
                    continue;
                }
                foreach ($ids as $j) {
                    if ($p === $j) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $labels = [];
                    foreach ($q[1] as $i => $x) {
                        if ($x > $this->available[$i] && $this->processes[$j]["alloc"][$i] > 0) {
                            $labels[] = chr(65 + $i);
                        }
                    }
                    if (!$labels) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $this->out("P$p -> P$j on " . implode(",", $labels));
                    $edges[$p][] = [$j, $j];
                    ++$edgeCount;
                }
            }
            if (!$edgeCount) {
                $this->out("no wait edges");
            }
        }
        $cycles = [];
        foreach ($ids as $start) {
            $visit = function ($p, $seen, $path) use (&$visit, &$cycles, $edges, $single, $start) {
                foreach ($edges[$p] as [$label, $next]) {
                    $extension = $single ? [$label, $next] : [$next];
                    if ($next === $start) {
                        if ($single || count($seen) >= 2) {
                            $cycles[] = array_merge($path, $extension);
                        }
                    } elseif ($next > $start && !in_array($next, $seen, true)) {
                        $visit($next, [...$seen, $next], array_merge($path, $extension));
                    }
                }
            };
            $visit($start, [$start], [$start]);
        }
        usort($cycles, function ($a, $b) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < min(count($a), count($b)); ++$i) {
                if ($a[$i] !== $b[$i]) {
                    return $a[$i] <=> $b[$i];
                }
            }
            return count($a) <=> count($b);
        });
        foreach ($cycles as $path) {
            $text = [];
            foreach ($path as $i => $x) {
                $text[] = $single && $i % 2 ? chr(65 + $x) : "P$x";
            }
            $this->out("cycle: " . implode(" -> ", $text));
        }
        if (!$cycles) {
            $this->out("no cycles");
        }
    }
}
$manager = new Manager();
$n = (int) trim(fgets(STDIN));
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; ++$i) {
    $manager->run(rtrim(fgets(STDIN), "\r\n"), $i);
}
